page.layout: One page of verse, set as a single column of italic lines, with the running head PROTREPTICON centred at the top. No margin notes, no notes below the text, no catchword or signature. The last line, Surrige, sits indented at the right.

main_text.l: Non expectato seruauit numine, fractam-
Tantis turbinibus rerum, tantisque procellis,
Et bonus asseruit nutantem extrema Geneuam,
Inter mille neces inter discrimina mille.
Quo magis haud meritum agnoscat magnumque
fauoremNuminis & tanto æternas pro munere grates-
Persoluat rediuiua, memor gratissima tanti-
Muneris, & puros seruet sanctissima ritus.
Nec tantum sat erat miseram de faucibus hostis-
Eripere, immeritóque iugo, & crudelibus armis,
Imperióq; Ducum, multos quos mœsta per annos-
Pertulit, & duras domini gens libera leges:
Nisi simul ad lucem Deus, & meliora vocasset-
E' nocte & tenebris quibus ante sepulta iacebat.
Sed mihi nec prima testes ab origine casus-
Sit memorare labor, hæc nostrum ad tempora carmēChriste
voca, & trepidū deduc per singula Vatem,
Si modò si liceat causas aperire latentes-
Funestíque odij, & subitos de nocte tumultus(
Vnius studio excitos) quibus inclyta nuper-
Arsit, quæ, sine te, iam-iam inclinata rucbat-
Vrbs tua, quam seruas inter tot bella metúsque.
Quo feror? & quo me sanctæ rapit impetus
iræ?Hac ô Musa tenus: tanto nam gurgite rerum-
Ancipitem incertúmque viæ, prius ærea lingua-
Et vox deficiant, quàm prima exordia libem.
Sunt longæ ambages, longa est iniuria, longi-
Exorsus, quos ipse olim si vita superfit,
Aut alij forsan post me venientibus annis-
Expedient, populíque canent tot gesta futuris:Interea
me parua sequi, me stringere littus-
Nunc iuuet; hoc pelago fragilem committere
lembūNil opus est, tutus potius ferar amne secundo.
Macte igitur, tu macte igitur seruata Geneua:
Surrige

page.notes: Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Printed ligatures and the et-sign (&) are kept as printed. Marginal text: none visible. The printed line "Surrige" is the last line of the page, with no catchword below it. Some words may need checking against the scan: "Vnius" and "rucbat" as printed; "E`" in "E' nocte" is a printed apostrophe-like mark. The word "iam-iam" keeps its printed hyphen. The line Nec tantum... begins indented, as does Quo feror, Sed mihi, and Macte igitur, marking paragraph starts.
